name: Aru Hi no Hi Nichijou
source:
It's been a few weeks since she entered university.
One day, when she came back home, she stumbled upon a man she didn't recognize.

He had previously been her computer.
The reason he gave for wanting to become human is that he "wanted to have fun"?!
Was that really all he was asking for?!

This is the story of a computer, who had been allowed to remain human for just three days, and its master, the protagonist.

[translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20161106072721/http://o3asterisk.com/g/nonday/]official website[/url]]
translation:
她升入大学已经几个星期了。
一天，她回到家时，偶然遇见一个陌生男人。

他以前是她的电脑。
他想变成人类的理由竟然是“想玩得开心”？！
他所求的真的只有这个吗？！

这是一个电脑和它的主人——主角——之间的故事。电脑获准以人类的身份生活三天。

[译自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20161106072721/http://o3asterisk.com/g/nonday/]官方网站[/url]]
